title: S4 paid warning and obstruction results
physical_scope_notes: All four mechanisms retain the same energetic register and bank. Sensor writing or response coupling differs explicitly.
Independent-register occupancy and total switching are calibrated to T0 at T64; actual path laws, bills and response-arm moments are not matched.
comparison_scope_notes: These are matched-endowment mechanism contrasts, not enacted choices or suffering-valence comparisons.
All native randomness counts; finite profiles are primary and rates/offsets are separate long-horizon diagnostics.
Register records, mortality, learned helplessness, anaesthesia and factory farming are not modeled.
engineering_note: Four largest-world smoke cases are retained separately; physical calibration used no entropy objective.
